meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会写小脚本操控浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据,页面状态在多次脚本之间保持,可分步推进一个流程。
howto.when: 当你要求打开网址、点击、填表等浏览器操作时触发。默认用独立模式新开 Chromium;也可用扩展模式接管你已登录的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截个图给我看看
say.note: 会启动浏览器并保存截图

say.text: 帮我登录这个网站,把订单列表抓下来
say.note: 扩展模式在你已登录的 Chrome 上运行

say.text: 填一下这个表单并提交,再告诉我结果
say.note: 脚本结束后页面状态仍保留

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes small scripts that drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, and scrape data. Page state persists across script runs, so a workflow can be built step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to go to a URL, click, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape, or test a site. Uses a fresh Chromium by default, or connects to your logged-in Chrome.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: Launches the browser and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Log into this site and scrape my order list
say_en.note: Extension mode uses your logged-in Chrome

say_en.text: Fill out this form and submit it, then tell me the result
say_en.note: Page state stays alive after the script ends
